public_api.note: Release 0.3.0 is the stable promotion of the qualified imports-to-reporting value chain delivered and cross-lot qualified in 0.3.0rc1. FEC source evidence and explicit import mappings flow through the canonical PostingOrchestrator into the ledger, TrialBalance, FinancialStatementEngine, published ReportSnapshot, regulatory projection, validation, export and evidence bundle. The package release is stable for the 0.3.x milestone, but the public Python API remains intentionally unfrozen before 1.0.
